info.name: Suggest concept URIs by name prefix

items.docs: Look up concept URIs (people, organizations, locations, things) by name prefix. Always resolve entity names to URIs using this endpoint before passing them to conceptUri filters in search operations.

info.name: Suggest category URIs by name prefix

items.docs: Look up news topic category URIs (business, tech, sports, etc.) by name prefix. Use returned URIs in categoryUri filters.

info.name: Suggest news source URIs by name prefix

items.docs: Look up news source URIs (e.g., Reuters, BBC) by name prefix. Use returned URIs in sourceUri filters.

info.name: Suggest location URIs by name prefix

items.docs: Look up location URIs (countries, cities, regions) by name prefix. Use returned URIs in locationUri or sourceLocationUri filters. Always use English location names.

info.name: Suggest author URIs by name prefix

items.docs: Look up journalist/author URIs by name prefix. Use returned URIs in authorUri filters.
